description: Versioned exchange-dependent values for NIFTY 50 index options. Nothing in strategy, risk or execution may hard-code these; read them through nifty_core.contracts. Source ids refer to config/sources.json.

lot_size.unit: index units per lot, looked up by the contract's expiry date (weekly and monthly contracts)

versions.notes: The circular's 'present market lot' on 2025-10-03; applies to weekly and monthly contracts up to the 30-Dec-2025 expiry. Earlier history not verified.

First weekly expiry on the revised lot is 06-Jan-2026, first monthly 27-Jan-2026. A search found no later NIFTY lot revision, but that is not proof: confirm against the current NSE_FO_contract_ddmmyyyy.csv.gz before relying on it.

weekly_expiry_weekday.unit: weekday number, Monday=0; looked up by the nominal expiry date. Also used for the monthly rule (last such weekday of the month).

versions.notes: THURSDAY (weekly: Thursday of the week; monthly: last Thursday). Start date of this rule not verified. Rule revised with effect from 2025-08-28 (EOD).

TUESDAY (weekly: Tuesday of the week; monthly: last Tuesday). The circular annexure moves the 04-Sep-2025 weekly expiry to 09-Sep-2025, so the week of 2025-09-01 has no weekly expiry and 2025-09-09 is the first weekly expiry on the new rule.

expiry_holiday_rule.unit: what happens when the expiry day is a trading holiday

versions.notes: NSE: 'If the Tuesday of the expiry period is a trading holiday, the contracts expire on the previous trading day.' Start date not verified.

tick_size.unit: INR price step for NIFTY index options

versions.notes: From the NSE contract specifications table (columns FUTIDX, OPTIDX, ...). The page text is flattened, so the OPTIDX column was read by position: the index-level tick table belongs to index futures and 0.05 follows for index options. Re-check on the live page if it matters.

strike_interval.unit: index points between strikes, weekly and monthly NIFTY contracts

versions.notes: NSE: strike interval 50 at all index levels, 35 ITM, 1 ATM, 35 OTM, for weekly and monthly contracts. Quarterly and half-yearly contracts use wider intervals and are out of scope.

session.unit: NIFTY options normal market open and close, IST

versions.notes: Believed to be the equity derivatives close before the CAS go-live, but not read from a primary document. Fixture mode only.
NSE: 'Equity Derivatives Segment: Session timings are 9:15 am to 3:40 pm'. Circular NSE/FAOP/75472: trading-modality changes in the Equity Derivatives segment effective in LIVE from 2026-08-03.
